zh: 对话行程卡新增日期按钮，默认显示第一天，每次查看一天的安排。
每天先预览最多四项安排，并标出其余数量；点“查看”可打开完整行程。
安排说明放在卡片上方，卡内显示标题、已知天数和安排数。
行程站点文字使用统一的浅色和深色主题配色。
en: Conversation itinerary cards now have day buttons, starting with day one and showing one day at a time.
Preview up to four stops per day with a remaining count. View still opens the complete itinerary.
The planning explanation sits above the card, followed by its title and known day and stop counts.
Itinerary stop text uses the shared light and dark theme colours.

zh: 与构建 46 相比，对话里的逐日展开改为单日预览，查看入口继续显示完整行程。
修复行程卡深色模式下站点文字的配色绑定。
en: Since build 46: conversation cards use a single-day preview instead of expanding every day; View keeps the complete schedule.
Fix the stop-text colour binding on dark itinerary cards.

zh: 打开已有行程的对话，确认卡片默认显示第一天，再切换到其他日期。
选择安排超过四项的一天，核对其余数量，再点“查看”检查完整安排。
在菜单切换浅色、深色模式，检查卡片文字和日期按钮。
在同一对话留一段草稿，切后台再回来，核对仍是同一对话和文字。
en: Open a chat with an existing itinerary, check that day one is selected, then choose another day.
Choose a day with more than four stops, check the remaining count, then use View to inspect the full schedule.
Switch between light and dark appearance in the menu and check the card text and day buttons.
Leave a draft in the same chat, switch apps and return, then check the chat and text are preserved.

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: 行程正式保存、修改与撤销，以及全国规划仍在验证。
“记住”偏好仍需单独完成真实验收。
部分大字号下的卡片显示或切日仍有问题，本轮先用系统默认字号。
分段、多选探索尚未默认开启；真机弱网和长时间锁屏恢复仍待完整验证。
en: Formal itinerary saving, edits and undo, and planning across China are still being validated.
Remember preferences still requires a separate live check.
Some larger text sizes still have card display or day-selection issues. Please use the system default size for this check.
Segmented, multiple-choice exploration is not the default. Physical-device weak-network and longer lock-screen recovery checks remain pending.

zh: 本版准备时，香港配套在线服务来源为 1ff3941e。
新的卡片界面需要更新应用；在线服务的调整会自动生效。账号资格和额度沿用既有规则。
en: At preparation, the paired Hong Kong service source is 1ff3941e.
The new card interface is included in this app update; online service changes apply automatically. Account qualification and allowances keep their existing rules.
Keep the same chat and each unsent draft when returning to the App.
During a recoverable connection check, keep the current chat visible instead of starting over.
Invitation entry avoids automatic capitalization and smart punctuation, and explains the required format.
Fix sign-in for valid test accounts that have no earlier demo content.
The information page keeps Done reachable after reading a long update.
zh: 回到应用时保留同一对话，以及各段对话里尚未发送的草稿。
遇到可恢复的连接检查时保留当前对话，不再重新开始。
邀请码输入关闭自动大写和智能标点，格式有误时直接说明正确格式。
修复有效测试账号缺少旧演示内容时无法完成登录的问题。
长篇说明翻到底后，仍能方便地点“完成”返回。

en: Since build 45: fix a local recovery problem that could be triggered by an unrelated pending message.
Ordinary travel wording no longer hides an otherwise complete reply. Original failed messages retain their original outcome.
zh: 与构建 45 相比：修复一种由无关待发消息触发的本机恢复问题。
普通旅行用语不再单独导致完整回答被隐藏；过去失败的消息仍保留当时结果。

en: Leave a draft in an existing chat, switch to another app, then return and check the same chat and text.
Force-quit and reopen, then check the same conversation and draft.
In new chats, ask “Who are you?” and “What can you do?” in Chinese or English.
Ask for a three-day trip to Beijing and check that all three days contain a concrete plan.
zh: 在已有对话中留一段草稿，切到其他应用后返回，核对同一对话和文字。
强制关闭应用后重开，检查同一对话和草稿。
新建对话，用中文或英文分别问“你是谁”“你能做啥”。
询问“北京三日游”，查看是否有完整三天的具体安排。

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

en: Formal itinerary saving, edits and undo, and planning across China are still being validated.
Remember preferences still requires a separate live check.
Segmented, multiple-choice exploration is not the default. Complete physical-device and weak-network acceptance remains pending.
zh: 行程正式保存、修改与撤销，以及全国规划仍在验证。
“记住”偏好仍需单独完成真实验收。
分段、多选探索尚未默认开启；真机与弱网完整验收仍待完成。

en: The paired Hong Kong service source 1ff3941e includes improvements to chat history, English city requests and lodging preferences.
These service changes apply automatically without a separate app update. Account qualification and allowances keep their existing rules.
zh: 配套香港服务来源为 1ff3941e，包含历史查看、英文城市理解及住宿偏好识别的改进。
这些服务端更新自动生效，无需单独更新应用；账号资格和额度维持既有规则。
